sql: WITH unified_asset AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (asset_code, asset_seq_no), REGEXP_REPLACE( UPPER( COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(machine_number), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(chassis_number), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(vehicle_plate_no), '') ) ), '[^A-Z0-9]+$', '' ) AS asset_id, asset_code AS backup_key, CONCAT(asset_code, '#', manufacturing_year) AS asset_code, COALESCE(asset_seq_no, 0) AS asset_seq_no FROM ( SELECT created_timestamp, avg_market_price AS otr_price, agreement_number, TRY_CAST(asset_seq_no AS INT) AS asset_seq_no, 1 AS source_no, asset_code FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_asset WHERE dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END ) ), unified_asset2 AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agreement_number, asset_seq_no ORDER BY created_timestamp, source_no) AS rn FROM unified_asset WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_id), '') IS NULL AND NOT TRIM(asset_id) IN ('', '0', '-') ), unified_asset2B AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn, otr_price), COALESCE( otr_price, LAG(otr_price, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp) ) AS otr_price FROM unified_asset2 WHERE rn = 1 ), sample_size2 AS ( SELECT asset_code, COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count, COUNT(DISTINCT agreement_number) AS contract_count FROM unified_asset2B GROUP BY asset_code ), unified_asset3 AS ( SELECT t1.* EXCEPT (asset_code, backup_key), ( CASE WHEN ( t2.asset_count < 30 ) AND ( t2.contract_count < 30 ) THEN backup_key ELSE t2.asset_code END ) AS asset_code FROM unified_asset2B AS t1 LEFT JOIN sample_size2 AS t2 ON t1.asset_code = t2.asset_code ), ranked_asset AS ( SELECT asset_id, asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp, asset_seq_no) AS row_idx FROM unified_asset3 WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0 ), one_representation AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM unified_asset3 ), rolling_feature AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM unified_asset3 WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0 ), ema_prep AS ( SELECT asset_code, row_idx FROM ranked_asset ), LogTransform AS ( SELECT asset_code, row_idx FROM ema_prep ), ema_feat_v1 AS ( SELECT * FROM LogTransform ), ema_prep2 AS ( SELECT * FROM ema_prep ), ema_feature AS ( SELECT tA.* FROM ema_prep2 AS tA INNER JOIN ema_feat_v1 AS tB ON tA.asset_code = tB.asset_code AND tA.row_idx = tB.row_idx ), ewm_prep AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM ranked_asset ), ewm_prep2 AS ( SELECT * FROM ewm_prep ), ewm_feature AS ( SELECT * FROM ewm_prep2 ), final_joined_view AS ( SELECT t0.* EXCEPT (event_timestamp), t1.* EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no, description_nunique, manufacturing_nunique, created_timestamp, manufacturing_year, next_production), t2.* EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no) FROM ranked_asset AS t0 LEFT JOIN one_representation AS t1 ON t0.asset_code = t1.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t1.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t1.asset_seq_no LEFT JOIN rolling_feature AS t2 ON t0.asset_code = t2.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t2.asset_seq_no LEFT JOIN ema_feature AS t3 ON t0.asset_code = t3.asset_code AND t0.row_idx = t3.row_idx LEFT JOIN ewm_feature AS t4 ON t0.asset_code = t4.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t4.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t4.asset_seq_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FROM unified_asset3 GROUP BY asset_code ) AS t5 ON t0.asset_code = t5.asset_code ) SELECT * FROM final_joined_view

ranked_asset AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp, asset_seq_no) AS row_idx FROM unified_asset3 WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0 ), one_representation AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM unified_asset3 ), rolling_feature AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM unified_asset3 WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0 ), ema_prep AS ( SELECT asset_code, row_idx FROM ranked_asset ), LogTransform AS ( SELECT asset_code, row_idx FROM ema_prep ), ema_feat_v1 AS ( SELECT * FROM LogTransform ), ema_prep2 AS ( SELECT * FROM ema_prep ), ema_feature AS ( SELECT tA.* FROM ema_prep2 AS tA INNER JOIN ema_feat_v1 AS tB ON tA.asset_code = tB.asset_code AND tA.row_idx = tB.row_idx ), ewm_prep AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM ranked_asset ), ewm_prep2 AS ( SELECT * FROM ewm_prep ), ewm_feature AS ( SELECT * FROM ewm_prep2 ), final_joined_view AS ( SELECT t0.* EXCEPT (event_timestamp), t1.* EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no, description_nunique, manufacturing_nunique, created_timestamp, manufacturing_year, next_production), t2.* EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no) FROM ranked_asset AS t0 LEFT JOIN one_representation AS t1 ON t0.asset_code = t1.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t1.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t1.asset_seq_no LEFT JOIN rolling_feature AS t2 ON t0.asset_code = t2.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t2.asset_seq_no LEFT JOIN ema_feature AS t3 ON t0.asset_code = t3.asset_code AND t0.row_idx = t3.row_idx LEFT JOIN ewm_feature AS t4 ON t0.asset_code = t4.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t4.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t4.asset_seq_no LEFT JOIN ( SELECT asset_code FROM unified_asset3 GROUP BY asset_code ) AS t5 ON t0.asset_code = t5.asset_code ) SELECT * FROM final_joined_view

NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0 ), one_representation AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM unified_asset3 ), rolling_feature AS ( SELECT asset_code, ema_prep2 AS ( SELECT * FROM ema_prep ), LogTransform AS ( SELECT asset_code, row_idx FROM ema_prep ), ema_feat_v1 AS ( SELECT * FROM LogTransform ), ema_feature AS ( SELECT tA.* FROM ema_prep2 AS tA INNER JOIN ema_feat_v1 AS tB ON tA.asset_code = tB.asset_code AND tA.row_idx = tB.row_idx ), ewm_prep AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM ranked_asset ), ewm_prep2 AS ( SELECT t5 ON t0.asset_code = t5.asset_code ) SELECT * FROM final_joined_view

WITH one_source_agreement AS ( SELECT dt, agreement_number FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_identity_resolution WHERE dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(agreement_number), '') IS NULL GROUP BY dt, agreement_number ), asset_prep1 AS ( SELECT t1.agreement_number, t2.* EXCEPT (dt, agreement_number), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.agreement_number ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM one_source_agreement AS t1 INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS t2 ON t1.dt = t2.dt AND t1.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number ), asset_prep2 AS ( SELECT agreement_number, TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS ts_id, created_timestamp AS event_timestamp FROM asset_prep1 UNION SELECT agreement_number, '{bizdate}' AS ts_id, TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp FROM asset_prep1 AS t2 WHERE t2.rn = 1 AND TRY_CAST(t2.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS DATETIME) ), contract_asset_feat AS ( SELECT agreement_number, /* ,ts_id -- for join multiple views */ ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agreement_number, ts_id ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM asset_prep2 ) SELECT agreement_number /* forward_fill */ FROM contract_asset_feat WHERE rn = 1

WITH loan_snapshot AS ( SELECT TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number, created_timestamp AS loan_created_timestamp FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan WHERE dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL AND CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) <> '1900' ), loan_ts_grid AS ( SELECT agreement_number, CAST(loan_created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM loan_snapshot WHERE NOT loan_created_timestamp IS NULL ), collection_scan AS ( SELECT TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number, dt AS ts_id FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection WHERE dt <= '{bizdate}' AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL ), loan_scan AS ( SELECT TRIM(agreement_number) AS agreement_number, dt AS ts_id FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan WHERE dt <= '{bizdate}' AND NOT agreement_number IS NULL ), collection_ts_grid AS ( SELECT DISTINCT agreement_number, ts_id FROM collection_scan UNION SELECT DISTINCT agreement_number, ts_id FROM loan_scan ), combined_ts_grid AS ( SELECT agreement_number, ts_id FROM loan_ts_grid UNION SELECT agreement_number, ts_id FROM collection_ts_grid UNION SELECT agreement_number, '{bizdate}' AS ts_id FROM loan_snapshot ), collection_agg AS ( SELECT agreement_number, ts_id FROM collection_scan GROUP BY agreement_number, ts_id ), loan_agg AS ( SELECT agreement_number, ts_id FROM loan_scan GROUP BY agreement_number, ts_id ), joined AS ( SELECT g.agreement_number FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT agreement_number FROM combined_ts_grid ) AS g LEFT JOIN collection_agg AS ca ON g.agreement_number = ca.agreement_number AND g.ts_id = ca.ts_id LEFT JOIN loan_agg AS la ON g.agreement_number = la.agreement_number AND g.ts_id = la.ts_id ), forward_filled AS ( SELECT agreement_number FROM joined ) SELECT agreement_number FROM forward_filled

WITH lookup_window_init AS ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(confins_application_id), '') AS applicationid, NULLIF(TRIM(lon.agreement_number), '') AS agreementno, NULLIF(TRIM(confins_customer_id), '') AS customerid, lon.dt, UPPER(TRIM(product)) AS productname, UPPER(TRIM(asset_type_id)) AS productgroup, GREATEST(golive_at, TRY_CAST(lon.application_date AS DATETIME)) AS event_timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(application_id, lon.agreement_number), confins_customer_id, product, asset_type_id ORDER BY lon.application_date DESC ) AS rn FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS lon LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast ON lon.agreement_number = ast.agreement_number AND lon.dt = ast.dt WHERE lon.dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT lon.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC') ), RO_DF_prep1 AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn /* re-occurence index */ FROM lookup_window_init WHERE customerid IN ( SELECT customerid FROM lookup_window_init WHERE productname = 'DF' AND productgroup = 'MOBIL' AND ( TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN STR_TO_TIME('20210101', 'yyyymmdd') AND STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') ) ) AND rn = 1 ), RO_DF_prep2 AS ( SELECT *, LAG(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_contract, LEAD(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS next_contract, COALESCE( TS_OR_DS_ADD( LEAD(event_timestamp, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp), -1, DD ), STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') ) AS upper_time_limit FROM RO_DF_prep1 ), RO_DF_feat3 AS ( SELECT rdp.*, col.created_timestamp AS collection_created, col.updated_timestamp AS collection_updated, /* customer demography */ LEAST(led.lead_created_at, led.created_timestamp) AS lead_created, led.updated_timestamp AS lead_updated, /* fee */ TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) AS loan_inserted, /* loan outstanding */ pay.created_timestamp AS payment_created, pay.updated_timestamp AS payment_updated, /* asset */ ast.created_timestamp AS asset_registered, pef.created_timestamp AS pefindo_created, pef.updated_timestamp AS pefindo_updated FROM RO_DF_prep2 AS rdp LEFT JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS lon ON lon.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND lon.dt = rdp.dt AND TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_region_odps AS vdr ON TRIM(lon.branch_id) = TRIM(vdr.id_branch) AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdr.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdr.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast ON ast.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND ast.dt = rdp.dt AND TRY_CAST(ast.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS led ON led.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid AND led.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(led.updated_timestamp, led.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS col ON col.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND col.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(col.updated_timestamp, col.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_score AS pef ON pef.application_id = rdp.applicationid AND pef.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(pef.updated_timestamp, pef.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_payment_summary AS pay ON pay.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid AND pay.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(pay.updated_timestamp, pay.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps AS csa ON TRIM(csa.applicationid) = rdp.applicationid LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS idr ON TRIM(idr.agreement_number) = rdp.agreementno AND idr.dt = rdp.dt LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_dim_supplier_odps AS sup ON TRIM(csa.supplierid) = TRIM(sup.id_supplier) AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN sup.effective_date AND COALESCE(sup.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) ), RO_DF_final AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn), ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY customerid, COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), productname, productgroup, rn, prev_contract, next_contract ORDER BY GREATEST( TRY_CAST(loan_inserted AS TIMESTAMP), asset_registered, COALESCE(lead_updated, lead_created), COALESCE(payment_updated, payment_created), COALESCE(pefindo_updated, pefindo_created), COALESCE(collection_updated, collection_created) ) ) AS rn FROM RO_DF_feat3 ), feature_set AS ( SELECT LAST_VALUE(agreementno) IGNORE NULLS OVER ( PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS agreement_number FROM RO_DF_final WHERE rn = 1 ), test_case AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (idx, event_timestamp) /* reorder field */ FROM feature_set ) SELECT * FROM test_case

WITH final_joined_view AS ( SELECT t0.* EXCEPT (event_timestamp), /* t0.asset_id */ /* ,t0.asset_code */ /* ,t0.agreement_number */ /* ,t0.asset_seq_no */ /* ,t0.otr_price */ /* ,t0.row_idx */ /* ,t0.lag_month */ t1.* EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no, description_nunique, manufacturing_nunique, created_timestamp, manufacturing_year, next_production), /* ,t1.asset_type */ /* ,t1.bpkb_ownership */ /* ,t1.bpkb_status */ /* ,t1.brand */ /* ,t1.stnk_status */ /* ,t1.tax_status */ /* ,t1.vehicle_category */ /* ,t1.vehicle_category_nunique */ t2.* EXCEPT (asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no) FROM ranked_asset AS t0 LEFT JOIN one_representation AS t1 ON t0.asset_code = t1.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t1.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t1.asset_seq_no /* 1m 17s */ LEFT JOIN rolling_feature AS t2 ON t0.asset_code = t2.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t2.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t2.asset_seq_no /* 1m 24s */ LEFT JOIN ema_feature AS t3 ON t0.asset_code = t3.asset_code AND t0.row_idx = t3.row_idx /* 1m 42s */ LEFT JOIN ewm_feature AS t4 ON t0.asset_code = t4.asset_code AND t0.agreement_number = t4.agreement_number AND t0.asset_seq_no = t4.asset_seq_no /* 1m 39s */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FROM unified_asset3 GROUP BY asset_code ) AS t5 ON t0.asset_code = t5.asset_code ), ranked_asset AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp, asset_seq_no) AS row_idx /* ,DATEDIFF(CAST(TO_DATE('20260626','yyyymmdd') AS DATETIME),CAST(created_timestamp AS DATETIME),'mm') AS lag_month */ FROM unified_asset3 WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0 ), unified_asset3 AS ( SELECT t1.* EXCEPT (asset_code, backup_key), /* if sample size too small then revert to asset code only without manufacturing year */ ( CASE WHEN ( t2.asset_count < 30 ) AND ( t2.contract_count < 30 ) THEN backup_key ELSE t2.asset_code END ) AS asset_code FROM unified_asset2B AS t1 LEFT JOIN sample_size2 AS t2 ON t1.asset_code = t2.asset_code ), unified_asset2B AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn, otr_price), /* forward fill */ COALESCE( otr_price, LAG(otr_price, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY created_timestamp) ) AS otr_price FROM unified_asset2 WHERE rn = 1 ), unified_asset2 AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY agreement_number, asset_seq_no ORDER BY created_timestamp, source_no) AS rn FROM unified_asset WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_id), '') IS NULL AND NOT TRIM(asset_id) IN ('', '0', '-') ), unified_asset AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (asset_code, asset_seq_no), REGEXP_REPLACE( UPPER( COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(machine_number), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(chassis_number), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(vehicle_plate_no), '') ) ), '[^A-Z0-9]+$', '' ) AS asset_id, asset_code AS backup_key, CONCAT(asset_code, '#', manufacturing_year) AS asset_code, COALESCE(asset_seq_no, 0) AS asset_seq_no FROM ( SELECT created_timestamp, avg_market_price AS otr_price, agreement_number, TRY_CAST(asset_seq_no AS INT) AS asset_seq_no, 1 AS source_no, asset_code FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_asset WHERE dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END ) ), sample_size2 AS ( SELECT asset_code, COUNT(DISTINCT asset_id) AS asset_count, COUNT(DISTINCT agreement_number) AS contract_count FROM unified_asset2B GROUP BY asset_code ), one_representation AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM unified_asset3 ), rolling_feature AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no /* asset_id -- replaced by asset_code */ /* 1. MEAN (AVG) translation over 90 Days and 6 Months lookback */ FROM unified_asset3 WHERE NOT NULLIF(TRIM(asset_code), '') IS NULL AND otr_price > 0 ), ema_feature AS ( SELECT tA.* /* ,ROUND(SUM((otr_price * alpha_v1_m3) / POWER(1.0 - alpha_v1_m3,row_idx)) OVER ( */ /* PARTITION BY asset_code ORDER BY event_timestamp ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING */ /* ) * POWER(1.0 - alpha_v1_m3,row_idx),2) AS otr_ema_v1_m3 -- exact trick */ FROM ema_prep2 AS tA INNER JOIN ema_feat_v1 AS tB ON tA.asset_code = tB.asset_code AND tA.row_idx = tB.row_idx ), ema_prep2 AS ( SELECT * FROM ema_prep ), ema_prep AS ( SELECT asset_code, /* asset_id -- replaced by asset_code */ asset_seq_no, row_idx /* Define constant alpha for a 90-period span: 2 / (90 + 1) = 0.021978 */ FROM ranked_asset ), ema_feat_v1 AS ( SELECT * FROM LogTransform ), LogTransform AS ( SELECT asset_code, asset_seq_no, row_idx FROM ema_prep ), ewm_feature AS ( SELECT * FROM ewm_prep2 ), ewm_prep2 AS ( SELECT * FROM ewm_prep ), ewm_prep AS ( SELECT asset_code, agreement_number, asset_seq_no FROM ranked_asset ) SELECT * FROM final_joined_view

WITH lookup_window_init AS ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(confins_application_id), '') AS applicationid, NULLIF(TRIM(lon.agreement_number), '') AS agreementno, NULLIF(TRIM(confins_customer_id), '') AS WITH score AS ( SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(s._load_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS last_score_timestamp FROM wsdatainnovation.cdp_score AS s INNER JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS l ON s.application_id = l.application_id AND l.dt = '{bizdate}' WHERE s.dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT l.confins_customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY l.confins_customer_id ) SELECT COALESCE(last_score_timestamp, TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyyMMdd') AS TIMESTAMP)) AS event_timestamp FROM score

WITH installment AS ( SELECT i.applicationid, TRY_CAST(i.duedate AS DATETIME) AS duedate, TRY_CAST(i.paiddate AS DATETIME) AS paiddate, CASE WHEN i.paiddate IS NULL THEN 'MISSED' WHEN i.paiddate < i.duedate THEN 'EARLY' WHEN i.paiddate = i.duedate THEN 'ONTIME' ELSE 'LATE' END AS payment_status FROM wsbfi_2.dwh_ods_installmentschedule_odps AS i WHERE TRY_CAST(i.duedate AS DATETIME) <= TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS DATETIME) ), stg_agreement AS ( SELECT application_id, confins_customer_id FROM ( SELECT applicationid AS application_id, TRIM(customerid) AS confins_customer_id FROM wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps WHERE TRIM(agreementno) <> '-' AND NOT golivedate IS NULL ) AS t WHERE rn = 1 ), mapped AS ( SELECT sa.confins_customer_id, ins.duedate, ins.paiddate, ins.payment_status FROM installment AS ins INNER JOIN stg_agreement AS sa ON TRY_CAST(ins.applicationid AS TEXT) = sa.application_id ), events AS ( SELECT confins_customer_id, CAST(duedate AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM mapped WHERE payment_status IN ('MISSED', 'LATE') UNION SELECT confins_customer_id, CAST(paiddate AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM mapped WHERE payment_status IN ('EARLY', 'ONTIME') UNION SELECT confins_customer_id, CAST(paiddate AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM mapped WHERE payment_status = 'LATE' ), event_agg AS ( SELECT confins_customer_id, ts_id FROM events GROUP BY confins_customer_id, ts_id ), customer_ts_grid AS ( SELECT confins_customer_id, ts_id FROM event_agg UNION SELECT confins_customer_id, '{bizdate}' AS ts_id FROM ( SELECT confins_customer_id FROM event_agg GROUP BY confins_customer_id ) AS t WHERE t.last_ts_id < '{bizdate}' ), joined AS ( SELECT g.ts_id FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ts_id FROM customer_ts_grid ) AS g LEFT JOIN event_agg AS ea ON g.confins_customer_id = ea.confins_customer_id AND g.ts_id = ea.ts_id ) SELECT TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME(ts_id, 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp FROM joined

WITH lookup_window_init AS ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(confins_application_id), '') AS applicationid, NULLIF(TRIM(lon.agreement_number), '') AS agreementno, NULLIF(TRIM(confins_customer_id), '') AS customerid, lon.dt, UPPER(TRIM(product)) AS productname, UPPER(TRIM(asset_type_id)) AS productgroup, GREATEST(golive_at, TRY_CAST(lon.application_date AS DATETIME)) AS event_timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(application_id, lon.agreement_number), confins_customer_id, product, asset_type_id ORDER BY lon.application_date DESC ) AS rn FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS lon LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast ON lon.agreement_number = ast.agreement_number AND lon.dt = ast.dt WHERE lon.dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT lon.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC') ), RO_DF_prep1 AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn /* re-occurence index */ FROM lookup_window_init WHERE customerid IN ( SELECT customerid FROM lookup_window_init WHERE productname = 'DF' AND productgroup = 'MOBIL' AND ( TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN STR_TO_TIME('20210101', 'yyyymmdd') AND STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') ) ) AND rn = 1 ), RO_DF_prep2 AS ( SELECT *, LAG(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_contract, LEAD(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS next_contract, COALESCE( TS_OR_DS_ADD( LEAD(event_timestamp, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp), -1, DD ), STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') ) AS upper_time_limit FROM RO_DF_prep1 ), RO_DF_feat3 AS ( SELECT rdp.*, col.created_timestamp AS collection_created, col.updated_timestamp AS collection_updated, /* customer demography */ LEAST(led.lead_created_at, led.created_timestamp) AS lead_created, led.updated_timestamp AS lead_updated, /* fee */ TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) AS loan_inserted, /* loan outstanding */ pay.created_timestamp AS payment_created, pay.updated_timestamp AS payment_updated, /* asset */ ast.created_timestamp AS asset_registered, pef.created_timestamp AS pefindo_created, pef.updated_timestamp AS pefindo_updated FROM RO_DF_prep2 AS rdp LEFT JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS lon ON lon.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND lon.dt = rdp.dt AND TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_region_odps AS vdr ON TRIM(lon.branch_id) = TRIM(vdr.id_branch) AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdr.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdr.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast ON ast.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND ast.dt = rdp.dt AND TRY_CAST(ast.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS led ON led.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid AND led.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(led.updated_timestamp, led.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS col ON col.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND col.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(col.updated_timestamp, col.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_score AS pef ON pef.application_id = rdp.applicationid AND pef.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(pef.updated_timestamp, pef.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_payment_summary AS pay ON pay.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid AND pay.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(pay.updated_timestamp, pay.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps AS csa ON TRIM(csa.applicationid) = rdp.applicationid LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS idr ON TRIM(idr.agreement_number) = rdp.agreementno AND idr.dt = rdp.dt LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_dim_supplier_odps AS sup ON TRIM(csa.supplierid) = TRIM(sup.id_supplier) AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN sup.effective_date AND COALESCE(sup.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) ), RO_DF_final AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn), ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY customerid, COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), productname, productgroup, rn, prev_contract, next_contract ORDER BY GREATEST( TRY_CAST(loan_inserted AS TIMESTAMP), asset_registered, COALESCE(lead_updated, lead_created), COALESCE(payment_updated, payment_created), COALESCE(pefindo_updated, pefindo_created), COALESCE(collection_updated, collection_created) ) ) AS rn FROM RO_DF_feat3 ), feature_set AS ( SELECT TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp FROM RO_DF_final WHERE rn = 1 ), test_case AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (idx, event_timestamp), /* reorder field */ event_timestamp FROM feature_set ) SELECT * FROM test_case

WITH joined AS ( SELECT g.phone_number, g.ts_id, COALESCE(fa.raw_event_timestamp, TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME(g.ts_id, 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP)) AS raw_event_timestamp FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT phone_number, ts_id FROM combined_ts_grid ) AS g LEFT JOIN followup_agg AS fa ON g.phone_number = fa.phone_number AND g.ts_id = fa.ts_id LEFT JOIN error_agg_dedup AS ea ON g.phone_number = ea.phone_number AND g.ts_id = ea.ts_id ), combined_ts_grid AS ( SELECT phone_number, ts_id FROM phone_ts_grid UNION SELECT phone_number, ts_id FROM followup_ts_grid UNION SELECT phone_number, ts_id FROM followup_multi_ts_grid UNION SELECT phone_number, ts_id FROM error_ts_grid ), phone_ts_grid AS ( SELECT phone_number, CAST(phone_registered_time AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM phone_unique_record UNION SELECT phone_number, '{bizdate}' AS ts_id FROM ( SELECT phone_number FROM phone_unique_record GROUP BY phone_number ) AS t WHERE DATEDIFF( TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS DATETIME), TRY_CAST(t.last_registered AS DATETIME), DD ) > 0 ), phone_unique_record AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn) FROM ( SELECT aps.* FROM valid_phone_stored AS aps WHERE NOT aps.phone_registered_time IS NULL ) AS sq WHERE sq.rn = 1 ), valid_phone_stored AS ( SELECT * FROM all_phone_stored WHERE NOT phone_number IS NULL AND NOT TRIM(phone_number) IN ('', '-', '0', '00', '000', '0000', '00000', '000000', '000000000000') AND LENGTH(TRIM(phone_number)) >= 8 AND NOT REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(phone_number), '^0*$') ), all_phone_stored AS ( SELECT t1.phone_number, cir.application_id, COALESCE(t2.updated_timestamp, t2.created_timestamp) AS phone_registered_time FROM ( SELECT phone_number FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead WHERE dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT phone_number IS NULL AND NOT lead_id IS NULL UNION SELECT spouse_phone_number AS phone_number FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead WHERE dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT spouse_phone_number IS NULL AND NOT lead_id IS NULL UNION SELECT phone_number FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution WHERE dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT phone_number IS NULL AND NOT lead_id IS NULL ) AS t1 LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS t2 ON t1.lead_id = t2.lead_id AND t2.dt = '{bizdate}' LEFT JOIN cir_snapshot AS cir ON t1.lead_id = cir.lead_id ), cir_snapshot AS ( SELECT DISTINCT lead_id, application_id FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution WHERE dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT lead_id IS NULL ), followup_ts_grid AS ( SELECT DISTINCT phone_number, CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM followup_snapshot WHERE NOT created_timestamp IS NULL ), followup_snapshot AS ( SELECT pam.phone_number, fu.* FROM phone_app_map AS pam INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan_engagement_follow_up_summary AS fu ON pam.application_id = fu.application_id AND fu.dt = '{bizdate}' ), phone_app_map AS ( SELECT DISTINCT phone_number, application_id FROM valid_phone_stored WHERE NOT application_id IS NULL ), followup_multi_ts_grid AS ( SELECT phone_number, CAST(first_call_at AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM followup_snapshot WHERE NOT first_call_at IS NULL UNION SELECT phone_number, CAST(first_follow_up_creating_schedule AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM followup_snapshot WHERE NOT first_follow_up_creating_schedule IS NULL UNION SELECT phone_number, CAST(first_customer_response_creating_schedule AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM followup_snapshot WHERE NOT first_customer_response_creating_schedule IS NULL UNION SELECT phone_number, CAST(first_follow_up AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM followup_snapshot WHERE NOT first_follow_up IS NULL UNION SELECT phone_number, CAST(first_customer_response AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM followup_snapshot WHERE NOT first_customer_response IS NULL UNION SELECT phone_number, CAST(first_time_initiate_appointment_at AS TEXT) AS ts_id FROM followup_snapshot WHERE NOT first_time_initiate_appointment_at IS NULL ), error_ts_grid AS ( SELECT DISTINCT phone_number, ts_id FROM error_codes ), error_codes AS ( SELECT pam.phone_number, fu.dt AS ts_id FROM phone_app_map AS pam INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan_engagement_follow_up_summary AS fu ON pam.application_id = fu.application_id AND fu.dt = '{bizdate}' WHERE NOT fu.error_code IS NULL GROUP BY pam.phone_number, fu.dt, fu.error_code ), followup_agg AS ( SELECT fs.phone_number, ftg.ts_id, MAX( CASE WHEN CAST(fs.created_timestamp AS TEXT) <= ftg.ts_id THEN fs.created_timestamp END ) AS raw_event_timestamp FROM followup_ts_grid AS ftg INNER JOIN followup_snapshot AS fs ON ftg.phone_number = fs.phone_number GROUP BY fs.phone_number, ftg.ts_id ), error_agg_dedup AS ( SELECT DISTINCT phone_number, ts_id FROM error_agg ), error_agg AS ( SELECT etg.phone_number, etg.ts_id FROM error_ts_grid AS etg INNER JOIN error_codes AS ec ON etg.phone_number = ec.phone_number AND etg.ts_id = ec.ts_id ) SELECT LAST_VALUE(raw_event_timestamp) IGNORE NULLS OVER ( PARTITION BY phone_number ORDER BY ts_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS event_timestamp FROM joined

WITH filtered_dim_supplier AS ( SELECT DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(id_supplier), '') AS supplier_id, UPPER(TRIM(supplier)) AS supplier_name, TRY_CAST(effective_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_timestamp, sk_supplier, sk_region, expiration_date FROM wsBFI_2.dwh_dim_supplier_odps WHERE row_is_current_ind = TRUE OR expiration_date >= TS_OR_DS_ADD(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), -15, YYYY) ), filtered_agreement_prep0 AS ( SELECT t1.supplier_id, NULLIF(TRIM(t2.applicationid), '') AS application_id, NULLIF(TRIM(t2.agreementno), '') AS agreement_number, GREATEST(newapplicationdate, approvaldate, agreementdate, effectivedate, golivedate) AS event_ts, productid FROM ( SELECT supplier_id FROM filtered_dim_supplier ) AS t1 INNER JOIN wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps AS t2 ON t1.supplier_id = NULLIF(TRIM(t2.supplierid), '') ), filtered_agreement_odps AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(application_id, agreement_number), supplier_id ORDER BY event_ts ) AS rn FROM filtered_agreement_prep0 ), filtered_fact_contract AS ( SELECT t2.sk_supplier, NULLIF(TRIM(id_application), '') AS application_id, NULLIF(TRIM(agreementno), '') AS agreement_number, STR_TO_TIME( TRY_CAST(GREATEST(sk_approval_date, sk_agreementdate, sk_application_date, sk_golive_date) AS TEXT), 'yyyymmdd' ) AS event_ts, sk_product FROM wsBFI_2.dwh_fact_contract_odps AS t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT sk_supplier FROM filtered_dim_supplier ) AS t2 ON t1.sk_supplier = t2.sk_supplier ), supplier_join_contract AS ( SELECT t1.*, t5.* EXCEPT (supplier_id, sk_supplier, rn) FROM filtered_dim_supplier AS t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COALESCE(t2.agreement_number, t3.agreement_number) AS agreement_number, t2.* EXCEPT (agreement_number, application_id, event_ts, supplier_rate), t3.* EXCEPT (agreement_number, application_id, event_ts, supplier_rate), GREATEST(t2.event_ts, t3.event_ts) AS contract_timestamp FROM ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn) FROM filtered_agreement_odps WHERE rn = 1 ) AS t2 FULL JOIN filtered_fact_contract AS t3 ON t2.agreement_number = t3.agreement_number ) AS t5 ON t1.supplier_id = t5.supplier_id AND t1.sk_supplier = t5.sk_supplier LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_product_odps AS vdp1 ON TRY_CAST(TRIM(t5.productid) AS INT) = vdp1.id_product AND TRY_CAST(t5.contract_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdp1.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdp1.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_product_odps AS vdp2 ON TRY_CAST(TRIM(t5.sk_product) AS INT) = vdp2.sk_product AND TRY_CAST(t5.contract_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdp2.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdp2.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) WHERE t5.rn = 1 ), joined_prep0 AS ( SELECT supplier_id, supplier_name, sk_supplier, sk_region, expiration_date, CAST(created_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id, created_timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY supplier_id, supplier_name, sk_supplier, sk_region, STR_TO_UNIX(created_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC ) AS rn FROM supplier_join_contract WHERE NOT created_timestamp IS NULL ), joined_table_prep1 AS ( SELECT COALESCE(t1.supplier_id, t2.supplier_id) AS supplier_id, COALESCE(t1.sk_supplier, t2.sk_supplier) AS sk_supplier, COALESCE(t1.sk_region, t2.sk_region) AS sk_region, COALESCE(t1.ts_id, t2.ts_id) AS ts_id, t1.* EXCEPT (supplier_id, supplier_name, sk_supplier, sk_region, ts_id, rn), t2.* EXCEPT (supplier_id, supplier_name, sk_supplier, sk_region, ts_id, rn) FROM ( SELECT * FROM joined_prep0 WHERE rn = 1 ) AS t1 FULL JOIN ( SELECT supplier_id, sk_supplier, sk_region, agreement_number, CAST(contract_timestamp AS TEXT) AS ts_id, contract_timestamp FROM supplier_join_contract WHERE NOT contract_timestamp IS NULL ) AS t2 ON t1.supplier_id = t2.supplier_id AND t1.supplier_name = t2.supplier_name AND t1.sk_supplier = t2.sk_supplier AND t1.sk_region = t2.sk_region AND t1.ts_id = t2.ts_id ), joined_table_prep2 AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (expiration_date, pengalamansejaktahun, pkddenganbfitahun, dob_showroom_owner, created_timestamp), FIRST_VALUE(expiration_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER ( PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY ts_id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING ) AS expiration_date, LAST_VALUE(created_timestamp) IGNORE NULLS OVER ( PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY ts_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS created_timestamp FROM joined_table_prep1 ), joined_feature_table2 AS ( SELECT * FROM joined_table_prep2 ), supplier_contract_prep3 AS ( SELECT * FROM joined_feature_table2 ), supplier_contract_prep4 AS ( SELECT *, TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(created_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS tmp_id1, TIME_TO_STR(TRY_CAST(contract_timestamp AS DATETIME), '%Y%m%d') AS tmp_id2 FROM supplier_contract_prep3 ), final_preparation AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY supplier_id, sk_supplier, sk_region, tmp_id1 ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC, expiration_date DESC ) AS rn_s2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY supplier_id, agreement_number, tmp_id2 ORDER BY contract_timestamp DESC ) AS rn_c2, TRY_CAST(contract_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp FROM supplier_contract_prep4 ), business_data_frequencies AS ( SELECT supplier_id, tmp_id1 AS ts_id, event_timestamp FROM final_preparation WHERE rn_s2 = 1 ), ranked_business_data AS ( SELECT supplier_id, ts_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, ts_id ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM business_data_frequencies ), mailing_frequencies AS ( SELECT supplier_id, tmp_id2 AS ts_id, event_timestamp FROM final_preparation WHERE rn_c2 = 1 ), ranked_mailing AS ( SELECT supplier_id, ts_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, ts_id ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM mailing_frequencies ), mailing_product AS ( SELECT supplier_id, tmp_id2 AS ts_id, event_timestamp FROM final_preparation WHERE rn_c2 = 1 ), ranked_product AS ( SELECT supplier_id, ts_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, ts_id ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM mailing_product ), aggregate_supplier_prep1 AS ( SELECT supplier_id, tmp_id1 AS ts_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, tmp_id1 ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC) AS rn, MAX(created_timestamp) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, tmp_id1) AS event_timestamp FROM final_preparation WHERE rn_s2 = 1 ), aggregate_view_s AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn) FROM aggregate_supplier_prep1 WHERE rn = 1 ), aggregate_contract_prep1 AS ( SELECT supplier_id, tmp_id2 AS ts_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, tmp_id2 ORDER BY event_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM final_preparation WHERE rn_c2 = 1 AND NOT tmp_id2 IS NULL ), aggregate_view_c AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn) FROM aggregate_contract_prep1 WHERE rn = 1 ), feature_view_tab0 AS ( SELECT COALESCE(tab_s.supplier_id, tab_c.supplier_id) AS supplier_id, COALESCE(tab_s.ts_id, tab_c.ts_id) AS ts_id, tab_s.* EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, event_timestamp), tab_c.* EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, event_timestamp), GREATEST(tab_s.event_timestamp, tab_c.event_timestamp) AS event_timestamp FROM aggregate_view_s AS tab_s FULL JOIN aggregate_view_c AS tab_c ON tab_s.supplier_id = tab_c.supplier_id AND tab_s.ts_id = tab_c.ts_id ), feature_view AS ( SELECT t1.* EXCEPT (event_timestamp), t2.* EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, rn, event_timestamp), t3.* EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, rn, event_timestamp), GREATEST(t1.event_timestamp, t2.event_timestamp, t3.event_timestamp, t4.event_timestamp) AS event_timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.supplier_id ORDER BY t1.event_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM feature_view_tab0 AS t1 LEFT JOIN ranked_business_data AS t2 ON t1.supplier_id = t2.supplier_id AND t1.ts_id = t2.ts_id AND t2.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ranked_mailing AS t3 ON t1.supplier_id = t3.supplier_id AND t1.ts_id = t3.ts_id AND t3.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN ranked_product AS t4 ON t1.supplier_id = t4.supplier_id AND t1.ts_id = t4.ts_id AND t4.rn = 1 ), feature_view_tab2 AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, event_timestamp, rn), event_timestamp FROM feature_view UNION SELECT * EXCEPT (supplier_id, ts_id, event_timestamp, rn), TRY_CAST(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') AS TIMESTAMP) AS event_timestamp FROM feature_view AS t2 WHERE t2.rn = 1 AND DATEDIFF(STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd'), TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS DATETIME), DD) < 0 ) SELECT event_timestamp FROM feature_view_tab2

WITH unified_customer AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tb1.cdp_uid, NULLIF(TRIM(tb1.agreement_number), '') AS agreement_number, tb1.dt FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS tb1 LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS tb2 ON tb1.lead_id = tb2.lead_id AND tb1.dt = tb2.dt LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS tb3 ON TRIM(tb1.agreement_number) = TRIM(tb3.agreement_number) AND tb1.dt = tb3.dt LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS tb4 ON TRIM(tb1.agreement_number) = TRIM(tb4.agreement_number) AND tb1.dt = tb4.dt WHERE tb1.dt = CASE WHEN '{bizdate}' < '20100101' THEN '20100101' ELSE '{bizdate}' END AND /* WHERE tb1.dt = '20260621' */ NOT NULLIF(TRIM(tb1.agreement_number), '') IS NULL ), window_feature1 AS ( SELECT cdp_uid, uc.agreement_number, COALESCE(co.updated_timestamp, co.created_timestamp) AS event_ts /* last updated timestamp of collection record */ FROM unified_customer AS uc INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS co ON uc.dt = co.dt AND uc.agreement_number = TRIM(co.agreement_number) WHERE co.dt = '{bizdate}' /* '20260621' -- */ AND NOT NULLIF(TRIM(co.agreement_number), '') IS NULL ), collection_view AS ( SELECT uc.cdp_uid FROM unified_customer AS uc INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS cl ON cl.dt = uc.dt AND uc.agreement_number = TRIM(cl.agreement_number) INNER JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS co ON co.dt = uc.dt AND uc.agreement_number = TRIM(co.agreement_number) INNER JOIN window_feature1 AS wf1 ON wf1.agreement_number = uc.agreement_number AND wf1.cdp_uid = uc.cdp_uid GROUP BY uc.cdp_uid ), feature_subset1 AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (bucket_code, default_code) FROM collection_view ), window_feature2 AS ( SELECT cdp_uid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cdp_uid ORDER BY event_ts DESC) AS rn FROM window_feature1 ) SELECT fs1.*, tb2.* EXCEPT (cdp_uid, rn) FROM feature_subset1 AS fs1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM window_feature2 WHERE rn = 1 ) AS tb2 ON fs1.cdp_uid = tb2.cdp_uid /* WHERE max_dpd_l1m IS NOT NULL */ /* OR max_dpd_l3m IS NOT NULL */ /* OR latest_collection_effectiveness IS NOT NULL */ /* OR latest_persona IS NOT NULL */

WITH parent_agreement_cte AS ( SELECT sv.cdp_uid, sv.ts_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY sv.cdp_uid, sv.ts_id ORDER BY TRY_CAST(ca.manufacturing_year AS INT) DESC, TRY_CAST(cl.golive_at AS DATETIME) DESC ) AS rn FROM feature_subset_v2 AS sv INNER JOIN cdp_identity_resolution AS ci ON sv.cdp_uid = ci.cdp_uid /* exist on both main tables */ LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS cl ON cl.dt = ci.dt AND cl.agreement_number = ci.agreement_number LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ca ON ca.dt = ci.dt AND ca.agreement_number = ci.agreement_number LEFT JOIN WITH lookup_window_init AS ( SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(confins_application_id), '') AS applicationid, NULLIF(TRIM(lon.agreement_number), '') AS agreementno, NULLIF(TRIM(confins_customer_id), '') AS customerid, lon.dt, UPPER(TRIM(product)) AS productname, UPPER(TRIM(asset_type_id)) AS productgroup, GREATEST(golive_at, TRY_CAST(lon.application_date AS DATETIME)) AS event_timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY COALESCE(application_id, lon.agreement_number), confins_customer_id, product, asset_type_id ORDER BY lon.application_date DESC ) AS rn FROM wsDataInnovation.cdp_loan AS lon LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast ON lon.agreement_number = ast.agreement_number AND lon.dt = ast.dt WHERE lon.dt = '{bizdate}' AND NOT lon.contract_status IN ('CAN', 'PRP', 'RJC') ), RO_DF_prep1 AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn), ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn /* re-occurence index */ FROM lookup_window_init WHERE customerid IN ( SELECT customerid FROM lookup_window_init WHERE productname = 'DF' AND productgroup = 'MOBIL' AND ( TRY_CAST(event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN STR_TO_TIME('20210101', 'yyyymmdd') AND STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') ) ) AND rn = 1 ), RO_DF_prep2 AS ( SELECT *, LAG(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS prev_contract, LEAD(COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS next_contract, COALESCE( TS_OR_DS_ADD( LEAD(event_timestamp, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp), -1, DD ), STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd') ) AS upper_time_limit FROM RO_DF_prep1 ), RO_DF_feat3 AS ( SELECT rdp.*, col.created_timestamp AS collection_created, col.updated_timestamp AS collection_updated, /* customer demography */ LEAST(led.lead_created_at, led.created_timestamp) AS lead_created, led.updated_timestamp AS lead_updated, /* fee */ lon.tenor, TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) AS loan_inserted, /* loan outstanding */ pay.created_timestamp AS payment_created, pay.updated_timestamp AS payment_updated, /* asset */ ast.created_timestamp AS asset_registered, pef.created_timestamp AS pefindo_created, pef.updated_timestamp AS pefindo_updated FROM RO_DF_prep2 AS rdp LEFT JOIN wsdatainnovation.cdp_loan AS lon ON lon.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND lon.dt = rdp.dt AND TRY_CAST(lon.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_vw_dim_region_odps AS vdr ON TRIM(lon.branch_id) = TRIM(vdr.id_branch) AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN vdr.effective_date AND COALESCE(vdr.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_asset AS ast ON ast.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND ast.dt = rdp.dt AND TRY_CAST(ast.created_timestamp AS DATETIME) < rdp.upper_time_limit LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_lead AS led ON led.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid AND led.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(led.updated_timestamp, led.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_collection AS col ON col.agreement_number = rdp.agreementno AND col.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(col.updated_timestamp, col.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_score AS pef ON pef.application_id = rdp.applicationid AND pef.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(pef.updated_timestamp, pef.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_payment_summary AS pay ON pay.confins_customer_id = rdp.customerid AND pay.dt = rdp.dt AND GREATEST(pay.updated_timestamp, pay.created_timestamp) < TRY_CAST(rdp.upper_time_limit AS TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.confins_stg_agreement_odps AS csa ON TRIM(csa.applicationid) = rdp.applicationid LEFT JOIN wsDataInnovation.cdp_identity_resolution AS idr ON TRIM(idr.agreement_number) = rdp.agreementno AND idr.dt = rdp.dt LEFT JOIN wsbfi_2.dwh_dim_supplier_odps AS sup ON TRIM(csa.supplierid) = TRIM(sup.id_supplier) AND TRY_CAST(rdp.event_timestamp AS DATETIME) BETWEEN sup.effective_date AND COALESCE(sup.expiration_date, STR_TO_TIME('{bizdate}', 'yyyymmdd')) ), RO_DF_final AS ( SELECT * EXCEPT (rn), ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY customerid, COALESCE(applicationid, agreementno), productname, productgroup, rn, prev_contract, next_contract ORDER BY GREATEST( TRY_CAST(loan_inserted AS TIMESTAMP), asset_registered, COALESCE(lead_updated, lead_created), COALESCE(payment_updated, payment_created), COALESCE(pefindo_updated, pefindo_created), COALESCE(collection_updated, collection_created) ) ) AS rn FROM RO_DF_feat3 ), feature_set AS ( SELECT LAST_VALUE(tenor) IGNORE NULLS OVER ( PARTITION BY customerid ORDER BY event_timestamp ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND
